Hardware Engineer (hybrid) - 2011668

*hybrid role requiring some on site work activity each week in San Jose CA office*

Meet the Team:

Cisco Systems is seeking a System Level Test Engineer to validate and ensure the quality of next-generation networking platforms, including switches, routers, and data center systems.

Who You Are:

In this role, you will drive end-to-end system validation across hardware, firmware, and software stacks, ensuring robust performance, scalability, and reliability under real-world and stress conditions.

Key Responsibilities:

System Validation & Integration

• Define and execute system-level validation strategies for complex networking platforms

• Validate end-to-end functionality across hardware, OS, and networking software stacks

• Perform feature, regression, interoperability, and scale testing

Test Development & Automation

• Develop automated test frameworks using Python, C/C++, or similar languages

• Build scalable validation environments for high-throughput networking systems

• Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation

Performance & Scale Testing

• Design and execute tests for throughput, latency, packet loss, and scale limits

• Validate system behavior under high traffic loads and real-world network conditions

• Analyze system performance across L2/L3 protocols and data center workloads

Debug & Root Cause Analysis

• Debug complex issues spanning ASICs, firmware, drivers, and network OS

• Perform root cause analysis using logs, traces, and lab instrumentation

• Collaborate with design and software teams to resolve issues efficiently

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with ASIC, hardware design, software, and architecture teams

• Influence design decisions by identifying system-level risks early

• Work with customers and field teams to reproduce and resolve issues

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

• 4+ years of experience in system validation, networking test, or hardware/software integration

• Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, switching)

• Experience with Linux systems and debugging tools

• Programming/scripting experience (Python, C/C++, or similar)

• Hands-on experience with system-level debugging and validation

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with data center networking (leaf-spine, VXLAN, EVPN)

• Familiarity with high-speed interfaces (Ethernet 25G/100G/400G, PCIe)

• Experience testing network operating systems (NX-OS, IOS-XR, or similar)

• Knowledge of traffic generators (Ixia, Spirent) and network test tools

• Experience with automation frameworks and large-scale testbeds

• Background in ASIC bring-up or platform validation
